items.prompt: Expected sequence is 4. A full-header packet at 6 has an unknown body type. What expected sequence follows?

options.why: This task emits GAP 4 5, consumes observed sequence 6, then reports the body error without business mutation.

options.text: 4, because every error rolls back sequence progress.
options.why: That is not this deliberately skip-forward exercise policy.

options.text: 6, because only missing packets are consumed.
options.why: The observed packet position is consumed too, so expected becomes seq+1.

options.text: 1, because every type error restarts the feed.
options.why: No such restart rule is specified.
